verdict.rationale: Quo's own docs show in-product AI insight features: recorded calls are automatically transcribed and summarized (quo-docs-23), AI call tags are a listed plan feature (quo-docs-27), and a marketing line promises to help 'spot issues' (quo-docs-28). These are per-call AI outputs, not broader data analysis or actionable suggestions. MCP-based summaries run in external agents, so they do not count as 'inside the product'. missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions or recommended actions, cross-conversation or workspace-level insights/analytics, documentation of what AI call tags and issue-spotting actually surface, independent or hands-on corroboration.
